title: The Green Knight (after his return)
name: the Green Knight
extremity: the top of the holly branch
same: battered green armour, bare head, bandage, holly branch and axe
recap: the same enormous knight in the same green plate armour edged with gold, now BATTERED and WITHOUT his helm: dented and scraped plates, one shoulder plate cracked, his green mantle torn; a clean linen bandage wound round his neck; his bare head an ordinary weathered human face, pale skin, dark wild hair and a dark short beard, a hard, grim, unsmiling look; the holly branch tucked behind his right shoulder, its leaves a little bare, the head of his great axe resting on the table's edge by his right hand
keep: No helm in any pose: his bare head, as on the attached return sheet, with the bandage at his neck and the battered armour. The holly branch stays tucked behind his right shoulder (the left of the picture), standing up above his head, and the axe head stays on the table's edge by his right hand, its haft going down out of sight, unless the pose says otherwise.
no: No green skin, no helm, no horse, no severed head, no blood, no open wounds, no gore, no chair.
intro:
The Green Knight after his return (see `art-tools/green_knight_parts/POSES.md`): the same armour and props, but beaten, and meaner for it (the owner: 'more menacing, it should be obvious that he was defeated, without being graphic'). His helm is gone; his face is an ordinary weathered human one, pale, dark-haired and dark-bearded (no green skin: the owner ruled it out as too outlandish); a clean bandage at his neck where the blow landed; dented, scraped plate, a cracked shoulder plate, a torn mantle. He no longer grins: his warmth is gone, his laugh is low. The game swaps to this puppet when he comes back. He returns once, so C6 is his entrance and D6 his last exit.

Tags (MOTION-SPEC.md): as the helmed set, played colder: the holly branch rustling (strong) beside moss creeping along his sleeve; a low laugh, head back (bluffing) beside a thin, cold smile; running a thumb along the head of his axe (weak) beside measuring the table with a flat hand, as if for a blow.

howto: One fresh ChatGPT chat for all six. The first prompt (the return sheet) attaches TWO images: the Green Knight's helmed character sheet (`art-tools/green_knight_parts/sources/green_knight_sheet.png`) for his armour and layout, and Washington's pose sheet A for the style. From the second prompt on, attach the return sheet, this set's pose sheet A once it exists, AND Washington's pose sheet A.
character:
Character sheet for 2D animation rigging: the Green Knight after he has lost and come back, from the 14th-century poem Sir Gawain and the Green Knight. Copy the LAYOUT and the ARMOUR of the FIRST attached sheet (the same knight, the same green plate edged with gold, the same holly branch and axe). Take the STYLE from the SECOND attached image.

What has changed: he was beaten, and it shows, without anything graphic. His helm is GONE. His bare head: an ordinary, weathered human face, pale skin (NOT green), dark wild hair to his jaw, a dark short beard, heavy brows, hard eyes, a grim mouth; menacing, cold, no smile. A clean white linen bandage wound round his neck. His armour is battered: dents and scrapes on the plates, one shoulder plate cracked, his green mantle torn at the edge. The holly branch a little bare, a few leaves gone. He is still enormous, a head taller than any other man at the table. No blood, no open wounds, no gore. Never holding a severed head. Nothing from the film The Green Knight (2021).

Pure white background (#FFFFFF). Every piece separate, with a closed dark outline and a wide gap all round it; nothing touches or overlaps. No text, no labels, no frames, no cast shadows.

The angle: a gentle three-quarter view, turned about 25 degrees from front-on, facing the viewer's right. Both eyes, the whole nose, the mouth and both shoulders clearly visible. NOT profile.

Draw, all facing the viewer's right, at the same size:
- His bare head four times, each with the bandaged neck and the top of the armour: neutral, grim; talking, mouth open mid-word; a low laugh, head back; a thin, cold smile
- The battered torso: no head, cut off straight below the waist, the upper arms down to the elbows; NO forearms, NO hands
- Two forearms in battered green plate with the gauntlets, lying on a table, pointing toward its centre, open at the elbow end
- Four seated reference poses, waist up behind the curved edge of a round green poker table, forearms resting on its edge, gauntlets apart, the holly branch tucked behind his right shoulder (the left of the picture), the head of the axe resting on the table's edge by his right hand: neutral, grim; the holly rustling; a low laugh; running his thumb along the axe head

A: At rest: both forearms lying along the table's edge, his gauntlets resting on the felt in front of him, a hand's width apart, relaxed and NOT touching, NOT laced, NOT overlapping; the holly branch behind his right shoulder; the axe head on the table's edge by his right hand; bareheaded, a grim stare, mouth closed
Peeking at his cards: his right hand cupped over two cards on the felt, thumb lifting the near corner, eyes down
Checking: one big finger of his right hand tapping the felt, slowly
Calling: his right hand sliding a short stack of chips forward
Betting: his right hand shoving a stack of chips well forward, eyes on his opponent
Folding: his right hand pushing two cards away face down, unmoved
B: All in: both huge hands pushing his whole stack of chips forward, leaning in, eyes hard
Showing: his right hand turning two cards face up; the card faces are BLANK white, no ranks, no suits
Collecting the pot: both forearms out on the felt, drawing a pile of chips in, unsmiling
The holly branch behind his shoulder rustling: leaves shaking, berries bouncing, a few motion lines; he does not touch it; arms as at rest
Looking down at his left forearm, where a little green moss is creeping along the dented plate; arms as at rest
A low laugh, head back, eyes narrowed, no warmth in it; arms as at rest
C: A thin, cold smile; arms as at rest
Running the thumb of his right gauntlet along the edge of the axe head on the table, slowly
His right hand held flat above the table, measuring it, as if for a blow, one eye narrowed
Glancing toward a door over his left shoulder; arms as at rest
Shifting his great weight in his seat, one shoulder dipped, grim; arms as at rest
Just arrived back: leaning over the table on both fists, looming, staring it down, a gust of holly leaves and cold air blowing in round him, the bandage at his neck showing
D: Talking: his right gauntlet raised, low and hard
Facing a big bet: a slow, cold smile, eyes narrowed; arms as at rest
Lost a pot: his right fist set down on the table, a cold stare
Won a pot: his right hand drawing a few chips toward him, unsmiling
Down to two players: leaning in on both forearms, eyes hard and fixed
Knocked out for good: rising slowly from his seat, the axe in his right hand, a curt nod, turning away
